MODULE prototype.laya_router

WORKFLOW route(request: Any) -> Any
    STATE
        session: Any
        prepared: Any
        navigated: Any
        choice: Any
        returned: Any
    STEP begin
        CALL prototype.begin(request=request) -> session
        NEXT navigate
    STEP navigate
        WHILE session.pending
            PROGRESS session.progress
            STOP WHEN session.done
            MAX DEPTH 8
            ON LIMIT DEFER unresolved
            DO
                CALL prototype.context(session=session) -> prepared
                IF prepared.release_phase
                    IF prepared.release_allowed
                        CALL prototype.release(session=prepared) -> session
                    ELSE
                        CALL prototype.reject(session=prepared) -> session
                ELSE
                    IF prepared.can_force
                        CALL prototype.unique(session=prepared) -> choice
                    ELSE
                        IF prepared.code_only
                            CALL prototype.abstain(session=prepared) -> choice
                        ELSE
                            CALL prototype.laya(session=prepared) -> choice
                    IF prepared.navigation_phase
                        CALL prototype.navigate(session=prepared,choice=choice) -> navigated
                        IF navigated.has_continuation
                            CALL prototype.resume(session=navigated) -> session
                        ELSE
                            CALL prototype.complete_navigation(session=navigated) -> session
                    ELSE
                        CALL prototype.apply(session=prepared,choice=choice) -> session
        NEXT finish
    STEP finish
        CALL prototype.result(session=session) -> returned
        STOP returned
